item.title: monome
item.description:
07/15/26

mlrws is a mlr adaptation for the Music Thing Workshop Computer created by dessertplanet. it is astonishingly well featured for such a tiny computer.

norns is sold out and we don't yet have a timeline for their return. however we did find some extra parts while cleaning up and managed to build a couple units, including one with original middle grey metal. (edit: now gone as well.)

also available again are b-stock grid and arc. for a limited time we're offering these at 20% off (compared to the normal 10% off).

item.title: monome
item.description:
05/23/26 - monome is twenty. we put together a photo collection. part how it happened, part work-art-life entanglement, part disbelief.

monome.org/twenty

deep thanks to so many of you here who supported and participated in this journey towards other ways of being.

item.title: monome
item.description:
04/23/26

here's more iii, where meadowphysics runs on the grid itself, sending MIDI notes by connecting directly to a workshop system. recall meadowphysics is a discontinued module and also a mode on the discontinued ansible. iii is a way to connect your grid/arc to a modular system using any midi-to-cv capable modules.
